briefs.label: Morning Brief
briefs.title: Consolidation, Compliance Cleanup & a Clearer Path to Schedule III
briefs.top: Michigan operators are finding stability nine months into the 24% wholesale tax, with demand holding steady and both gubernatorial campaigns now courting the industry on repeal — while Bay City just put cannabis dollars to visible civic use. Nationally, Curaleaf is sweetening its Aurora bid as consolidation accelerates, and federal rescheduling and psychedelic-medicine reviews keep inching toward the finish line despite a procedural pause.

local.text: Bay City funds homeless shelter with weed tax dollars
local.text_full: Bay City funds homeless shelter with weed tax dollars — Commissioners are voting to send $150,000 a year in marijuana tax revenue to the Good Samaritan Rescue Mission Drop-In Center, a visible win for cannabis-tax goodwill.
